items.label: POWERFUL PROCESSOR PERFORMANCE
items.value: This 2 in 1 tablet laptop is powered by the Intel Pentium Gold Processor 6500Y (up to 3.4GHz) for smoothly run office 365, creative software, multiple browser tabs, and video calls without slowdowns, and reliable productivity across business, office, students, work, and entertainment

items.label: AMPLE STORAGE & MEMORY FOR YOUR FILES & MEDIA
items.value: Start with 8 GB RAM and 256 GB SSD for fast boot-ups and app loading, easily meeting your growing library of photo, video, and document

items.label: ULTRA-PORTABLE DESIGN & ROBUST BUILD FOR EVERYDAY CARRY

items.label: VERSATILE CONNECTIVITY
